brief:
Co-founder Huda Ammori is pursuing a legal challenge against the British government's designation of Palestine Action as a terrorist organization, according to Al-Monitor. The case resumes Wednesday at the UK's highest court as Ammori contests the official classification of the pro-Palestinian activist group.

The legal battle centers on the government's authority to designate Palestine Action under terror laws and whether the group's activities warrant such classification. The outcome could set precedent for how Britain regulates protest movements focused on Palestinian issues.
dek: A legal battle over a ban on Palestine Action activists resumes Wednesday as co-founder Huda Ammori takes her fight against the government's designation of the group as a terrorist organisation to Britain's highest court.
title: UK's highest court hears challenge to Palestine Action terror ban
